content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIM Udaipur Research Assistant (RA) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Udaipur Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Research Assistant (RA) position at IIM Udaipur is 10th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Research Assistant (RA) position announced by IIM Udaipur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s degree or above in social sciences, preferably in fields like Education, Sociology, Anthropology, Development Studies, Public Policy, or Economics.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Research Assistant (RA) role will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for the IIM Udaipur Research Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply for the Research Assistant (RA) position by sending their complete application via email.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The Research Assistant (RA) position at IIM Udaipur is a contractual job.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website of IIM Udaipur?
faq.answer: The official website of the Indian Institute of Management Udaipur is www.iimu.ac.in.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates should attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs with their application.

faq.question: Q10. When will the project start after the application deadline?
faq.answer: The project is scheduled to commence on 01st October 2026, following the application deadline.
